fusions.name: Barbed Hack
fusions.desc: A hack that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hatchet Swarm
fusions.desc: Flings 4 small hatchets at once in a spread, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Hive Work
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and gains 1 power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousand Stings
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
